rationale: Both Jessie and Griffin are building robotics systems but from complementary angles—Jessie as a hardware test engineer at Sesame AI and Griffin as a software engineer at Kiso Technology with deep embedded systems expertise (Python, Java, CUDA). Their combination of hardware validation rigor and low-level software skills (especially embedded systems and CUDA programming) could unlock stronger integration between hardware testing and performance optimization.
intro_message: Jessie Fan, meet Griffin — you're both working on robotics systems and could benefit from each other's hardware-software perspective, especially around embedded systems and performance validation.
